definition: Before the composer places any diagram from further down its ranked list, it asks each one, in score order, one short question: does this house hold every fact of its type it was asked to hold. Those that hold are placed first.
more: A probe is a question and not a placement. The diagrams nobody could call in the time are placed next, and those refuted at that depth last. Refuted at that depth is not a proof that a house cannot be drawn: it may hold a little deeper, which only its placement asks. Nothing is dropped by a probe, and the time it takes is the set's own.
basis: Our wording of the composer's deciding pass. build/compose.py: "each pool diagram is asked one question in score order", "and the fill then places the ones that HELD first, in score order", and a "diagram refuted at the derived depth may hold two feet deeper, which only its placement asks."
